			<div class="l-mainContent__inner" data-clarity-region="article">
				<h1 class="c-pageTitle" data-style="b_bottom"><span class="c-pageTitle__inner">【in Miyako Island】Kiteboarding Camp School</span></h1>								<div class="post_content">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><img decoding="async" width="1024" height="1015" src="data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACH5BAEKAAEALAAAAAABAAEAAAICTAEAOw==" data-src="https://x-fly.jp/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/宮古島のキレイな海で-カイトうまくなりましょう！.png-1024x1015.jpg" alt="" class="wp-image-4542 lazyload" data-srcset="https://x-fly.jp/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/宮古島のキレイな海で-カイトうまくなりましょう！.png-1024x1015.jpg 1024w, https://x-fly.jp/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/宮古島のキレイな海で-カイトうまくなりましょう！.png-300x297.jpg 300w, https://x-fly.jp/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/宮古島のキレイな海で-カイトうまくなりましょう！.png-150x150.jpg 150w, https://x-fly.jp/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/宮古島のキレイな海で-カイトうまくなりましょう！.png-768x761.jpg 768w, https://x-fly.jp/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/宮古島のキレイな海で-カイトうまくなりましょう！.png.jpg 1080w" sizes="(max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px"  data-aspectratio="1024/1015"><noscript><img decoding="async" width="1024" height="1015" src="https://x-fly.jp/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/宮古島のキレイな海で-カイトうまくなりましょう！.png-1024x1015.jpg" alt="" class="wp-image-4542" srcset="https://x-fly.jp/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/宮古島のキレイな海で-カイトうまくなりましょう！.png-1024x1015.jpg 1024w, https://x-fly.jp/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/宮古島のキレイな海で-カイトうまくなりましょう！.png-300x297.jpg 300w, https://x-fly.jp/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/宮古島のキレイな海で-カイトうまくなりましょう！.png-150x150.jpg 150w, https://x-fly.jp/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/宮古島のキレイな海で-カイトうまくなりましょう！.png-768x761.jpg 768w, https://x-fly.jp/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/宮古島のキレイな海で-カイトうまくなりましょう！.png.jpg 1080w" sizes="(max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" ></noscript></figure>
<p class="has-swl-deep-02-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-1 wp-block-paragraph"><kbd><span class="swl-fz u-fz-xl"><strong>3days ¥66,000</strong></span></kbd>(tax include) <br>＋¥17,000 per day<br>※If the specified accommodation is booked, we cannot make a reservation for you. In that case, please make your own reservation at another accommodation. We will give you a cash back of ¥4,000 per day.</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">School starts in 2025!<br>A training camp kite school, like a training camp driver&#8217;s license!<br>We&#8217;ll also be holding a period where we can hold school in Miyakojima, probably the easiest spot in Japan to practice!<br>This means you can practice in the warmth even in winter &#x1f525;</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><br>※*The event dates vary from year to year. In 2025, the event will be held from November 27th to January 13th.</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">【Include】<br>・Miyakojima guesthouse accommodation fee
(If the accommodation is fully booked and you are unable to make a reservation, we will refund ¥4,000 per day, so please pay this yourself.)
・Kiteboarding school fee
・Equipment rental fees
・Miyakojima guesthouse shower fee
・Insurance fee</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><br></p>
<div class="wp-block-group"><div class="wp-block-group__inner-container is-layout-constrained wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained">
<details class="wp-block-details u-mb-ctrl u-mb-5 has-white-color has-swl-deep-04-background-color has-text-color has-background has-link-color wp-elements-2 is-layout-flow wp-block-details-is-layout-flow"><summary>【FAQ】</summary>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Q: Will I get a refund if I want to stay at a different accommodation?
A: If there are spaces available at the accommodation and you wish to stay at a different accommodation, there will be no refund. Thank you for your understanding.
Q: Do I need a rental car?
A: A rental car is necessary. It will be inconvenient for transportation and daily life. There are some rare cases where avid foreigners choose to stay by bicycle, but in that case, please do not be discouraged and keep trying.</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>
</details>
</div></div>
